name: XLR
summary: XLR is a multiplayer team based arena shooter. Party up into teams (with friends, or just join a random match), select a player class, then deploy to the arena for battle. Or practice your skills against enemies in singleplayer training mode. Choose from different player classes to even the odds.

name: XLarn
summary: This is a heavily extended version of one of the most famous roguelike games of the 80's named Larn. Your choice is to find a magic elixier for your daughters recovery. Therefore you have to explore a lot of unknown caves, filled with monsters, demons and traps. Good luck! You may need it!

name: XL1: Clipping Point
summary: XL1: Clipping Point is an online racing game behind the developers of ArcheAge. In an effort to preserve the very first game that XLGames created, XL1 was added free on Steam to download.

name: X*L*C*R: Squiggly Snake II
summary: Is an arcade game mix of Tetris and Snake.

name: XLM's Dr. Harrison
summary: XLM's Dr. Harrison is a puzzle, action/reflex, maze video game for Windows 3.1, created and published in 1995.

name: Xlands
summary: This is a virtual world app focused on fashion styling, virtual living experiences, and social interactions. Here, there are no monsters to defeat, no quests to complete—just relaxing gameplay that gives you more time to bond with friends. Of course, you can also host or join events, design outfits, decorate homes, and even build your own brand to create a business empire. You can also create interactive scenes to invite your friends on adventures. Everything is designed to be leisurely and enjoyable.
